summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (L32) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether succinate retains metabolic/healthspan phenotype after SUCNR1/GPR91 genetic loss-of-function or matched antagonism abolishes SUCNR1-class attribution. The document is a research discussion framing a pre-registered rodent panel design, cataloguing existing literature (He 2004, McCreath 2015, Haffke 2019, Keiran 2019) as receptor/ligand necessity tools rather than residual-positive evidence, and declaring the residual-positive succinate metabolic/healthspan H2H under SUCNR1 abolish as UNKNOWN/EMPTY. No experiments have been run; the document is at TRL 1–2 (concept with literature grounding).

content_blocks.title: Hypothesis Overview and Claim (L32)
content_blocks.content: L32 is a hypothesis/assumption-kill card asking whether succinate retains metabolic/healthspan phenotype on a pre-registered rodent panel (He/McCreath/Haffke/Keiran-class) after SUCNR1/GPR91 genetic LOF or SUCNR1-matched antagonism (e.g., NF-56-EJ40-class/Haffke-class) abolishes SUCNR1-class metabolic/inflammatory/BP attribution. The primary claim: under an abolish lock, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (succinate vs vehicle under abolish) retains ≥50% of the succinate vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on SUCNR1-intact concurrent controls. The residual-positive succinate metabolic/healthspan H2H under mammalian Sucnr1/SUCNR1 abolish is declared UNKNOWN/EMPTY (Q_resid_life_h2h=0). Execution status: NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Scientific Rationale
content_blocks.content: Succinate metabolic, inflammatory, BP, and healthspan attributions are often framed as SUCNR1/GPR91-necessary because succinate is the endogenous SUCNR1 ligand. However, a matched residual-positive succinate metabolic/healthspan H2H under mammalian Sucnr1/SUCNR1 abolish remains UNKNOWN/EMPTY. The card asks whether, once SUCNR1/GPR91 LOF or SUCNR1-matched antagonism abolishes SUCNR1-class attribution, succinate still retains metabolic/healthspan phenotype — i.e., whether succinate metabolic/healthspan is a mere SUCNR1-sole-necessity bridge or has additional mechanisms (e.g., Complex II/SDH/HIF intracellular paths). Explicitly distinct from L15–L31 (different targets: HCAR1, HCAR2, PHD2, TauT, Klb, AMPK, SIRT1, etc.).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content:
Four literature pillars are identified as necessity/tool evidence (NOT residual-positive H2H):
1. He Nature 2004 (PMID 15141213): GPR91/SUCNR1 = succinate receptor; succinate-induced hypertensive effect abolished in GPR91-deficient mice — receptor+ligand foundation + BP-class SUCNR1 necessity AGAINST residual on BP.
2. McCreath Diabetes 2015 (PMID 25352636): Sucnr1-/- targeted disruption → dichotomous obesity/energy-expenditure phenotype; Sucnr1(-/-) released from succinate-induced inhibition of lipolysis — Sucnr1 genetic LOF metabolic tool + lipolysis-class necessity.
3. Haffke Nature 2019 (PMID 31645725): Structural basis of species-selective antagonist binding to SUCNR1; human-selective antagonist NF-56-EJ40 — SUCNR1-matched antagonist tool.
4. Keiran Nat Immunol 2019 (PMID 30962591): SUCNR1 controls anti-inflammatory macrophage program regulating metabolic response to obesity; myeloid SUCNR1 deficiency worsens metabolic obesity — LOF/mechanism replicate.
Non-SUCNR1 caveat: Complex II/SDH/HIF intracellular paths support possible residual — document but do not invent organismal longevity residual.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Experimental Design (Assay Method)
content_blocks.content: Method: propose-assay. Design: Pre-registered rodent metabolic/early-healthspan/BP-attribution panel (He/McCreath/Haffke/Keiran-class). Arms: exogenous succinate vs vehicle under (a) Sucnr1/SUCNR1 genetic LOF or SUCNR1-matched antagonism (abolish arm) and (b) SUCNR1-intact concurrent controls. Primary endpoint: same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (succinate vs vehicle under abolish) retains ≥50% of succinate vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on SUCNR1-intact concurrent controls. Preferred sequence: cell/tissue/block-QC (SUCNR1-class metabolic/inflammatory/BP-attribution QC abolish) before new animal longevity runs. Refute window: 4 weeks. Kill cost tier: 1. No human dosing language. No invented residual effect sizes or KD/IC50.

content_blocks.title: Refute Criteria and Competing Outcomes
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered rodent panel where Sucnr1/SUCNR1 LOF or SUCNR1-matched antagonism locks SUCNR1-class control benefit abolished, same-panel early healthspan/metabolic improvement (succinate vs vehicle under abolish) is <50% of the succinate vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement on SUCNR1-intact concurrent controls — indicating succinate metabolic/inflammatory/BP/healthspan reduces to mere SUCNR1-necessary bridge and the sucnr1-insufficiency assumption-kill fails — when abolish-fail, succinate-alone-null, underpowered-strata, assay-mismatch, or Complex-II-or-HIF-confound artifacts are ruled out. Competing inconclusive outcomes: abolish-fail (block not actually abolishing SUCNR1-class control), succinate-alone-null on SUCNR1-intact arm, underpowered strata, referee-assay mismatch, or Complex-II-or-HIF-confound-without-selective-confirmation.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Prior Art Status
content_blocks.content:
PRIOR_ART STATUS: PARTIAL.
- BP necessity FOUND (He 2004, PMID 15141213) — necessity AGAINST residual on BP ≠ residual-positive retain.
- Lipolysis/metabolic necessity FOUND (McCreath 2015, PMID 25352636) — LOF tool ≠ residual-positive.
- Antagonist structural tool FOUND (Haffke 2019, PMID 31645725) — ≠ residual H2H.
- Myeloid LOF/mechanism FOUND (Keiran 2019, PMID 30962591) — ≠ residual-positive succinate-in-KO retain.
- Residual-positive succinate metabolic/healthspan H2H under mammalian Sucnr1/SUCNR1 abolish: UNKNOWN/EMPTY.
- Longevity/healthspan-class residual: EMPTY.
- Soft-complete empty ≠ novelty / ≠ failure.
- L1–L31 ≠ proof of L32.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations and Distinctness from L15–L31
content_blocks.content:
Key limitations and distinctness flags:
1. L1–L31 do not prove L32 — new parent area succinate-sucnr1-insufficiency.
2. He BP abolish ≠ residual-positive retain; McCreath/Keiran ≠ residual-positive; Haffke ≠ residual H2H; Complex II/HIF co-mention ≠ invented longevity residual.
3. Critical receptor/ligand distinctness: SUCNR1 ≠ HCAR1 (L31, lactate); SUCNR1 ≠ HCAR2 (L30, BHB); SUCNR1 ≠ PHD2 (L29, αKG); SUCNR1 ≠ TauT (L28, taurine); SUCNR1 ≠ Klb/FGFR1 (L27, FGF21); SUCNR1 ≠ MT/melatonin (L26); SUCNR1 ≠ SIRT1 (L25); SUCNR1 ≠ SGLT2 (L24); SUCNR1 ≠ GSK3 (L23); SUCNR1 ≠ AMPK primary (L22); SUCNR1 ≠ mitophagy (L21); SUCNR1 ≠ bulk ATG (L20).
4. Succinate ≠ lactate (CRITICAL); succinate ≠ BHB (CRITICAL).
5. NOT NAD-after-senolysis (SERIES_FROZEN).
6. Do not invent residual effect sizes or KD/IC50.

key_findings: L32 is a NOT_RUN hypothesis card (TRL 1): no experiments have been executed; the residual-positive succinate metabolic/healthspan H2H under mammalian Sucnr1/SUCNR1 abolish is UNKNOWN/EMPTY (Q_resid_life_h2h=0).

He 2004 (PMID 15141213, Nature): GPR91/SUCNR1 identified as succinate receptor; succinate-induced hypertensive effect abolished in GPR91-deficient mice — establishes receptor+ligand foundation and BP-class SUCNR1 necessity, but is AGAINST residual on BP endpoint, not residual-positive retain.

McCreath 2015 (PMID 25352636, Diabetes): Sucnr1-/- targeted disruption leads to dichotomous obesity/energy-expenditure phenotype; Sucnr1(-/-) released from succinate-induced inhibition of lipolysis — Sucnr1 genetic LOF metabolic tool + lipolysis-class necessity, NOT residual-positive.

Haffke 2019 (PMID 31645725, Nature): Structural basis of species-selective antagonist binding to SUCNR1; human-selective antagonist NF-56-EJ40 characterized — SUCNR1-matched antagonist tool, NOT a residual H2H experiment.

Keiran 2019 (PMID 30962591, Nat Immunol): Myeloid SUCNR1 deficiency worsens metabolic obesity by disrupting anti-inflammatory macrophage program — LOF/mechanism replicate, NOT residual-positive succinate-in-KO retain.

Prior art status is PARTIAL: receptor+ligand+BP necessity FOUND; Sucnr1 metabolic LOF tool FOUND; antagonist tool FOUND; myeloid LOF/mechanism FOUND; residual-positive under abolish EMPTY; longevity residual EMPTY.

Proposed experimental design: pre-registered rodent panel with exogenous succinate vs vehicle under Sucnr1/SUCNR1 LOF or SUCNR1-matched antagonism (abolish arm) vs SUCNR1-intact concurrent controls; primary gate = ≥50% retention of succinate vs vehicle early healthspan/metabolic improvement under abolish vs intact arm.

Refute criterion: block-arm early healthspan/metabolic improvement <50% of intact-arm succinate vs vehicle improvement (when confounds ruled out) would indicate succinate metabolic/healthspan reduces to mere SUCNR1-necessary bridge.
Complex II/SDH/HIF non-SUCNR1 intracellular paths acknowledged as possible residual mechanism — document as caveat; do not invent organismal longevity residual from Complex II/HIF alone.
Critical distinctness: SUCNR1 ≠ HCAR1 (succinate ≠ lactate); SUCNR1 ≠ HCAR2 (succinate ≠ BHB); L31 and L30 are NON-MATCH to L32.
Kill cost tier 1; time to refute estimated at 4 weeks; preferred sequence is cell/tissue/block-QC before new animal longevity runs.
